name: EURO3
oneLiner: EURO3 is 3A DAO's overcollateralized euro stablecoin, minted on Polygon and Linea against whitelisted crypto and stablecoin collateral in user-owned vaults.
collateral: Whitelisted crypto and stablecoin collateral in 3A Vaults on Polygon and Linea, including USDC.e, DAI, WETH/ETH, USDT, WBTC, wstETH, and other wrapped or yield-bearing assets depending on chain
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized vault minting and redemption: users mint EURO3 loans against approved collateral, repay debt to burn EURO3, and can redeem EURO3 against vault collateral when the protocol's redemption conditions are met

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: EURO3 can be minted against supported stablecoin collateral such as USDC.e and USDT, so upstream freeze exposure is possible even though no direct holder blacklist override was authored for the EURO3 token.

mintAuthority.summary: EURO3 is minted from user-owned 3A Vaults on Polygon and Linea against whitelisted crypto and stablecoin collateral; the 3A DAO governs the accepted collateral whitelist and redemption/risk parameters.

controls.label: 3A Vault contracts (collateral mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by per-vault overcollateralization against whitelisted collateral; users repay to burn EURO3 and redemptions are allowed under protocol conditions.
controls.evidence: Users mint EURO3 loans against approved collateral in 3A Vaults and burn EURO3 on repayment, per 3A docs.

controls.label: 3A DAO governance
controls.evidence: The 3A DAO governs the whitelisted collateral set and redemption/risk parameters; it tunes parameters rather than minting directly.

review.evidence: 3A docs describe EURO3 as an overcollateralized vault stablecoin on Polygon and Linea with DAO-governed collateral whitelisting and redemption mechanics; no centralized direct-mint route is described.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Vault mechanism and DAO governance confirmed from 3A docs; on-chain vault admin owner and DAO execution path not independently read on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain 3A vault admin/owner and DAO execution authority on Polygon/Linea.

reserves.name: Whitelisted vault crypto and stablecoin collateral

notices.title: Live collateral mix not modeled
notices.message: 3A documents the approved vault collateral set and redemption mechanics, but no Pharos-supported live adapter or stable public mainnet collateral-composition feed was found during this addition.
